title: Brick Dust
description: Put <keyword>terracotta</keyword> on a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/tree_stump'><u>Tree Stump</u></click> with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, then hit it with a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/lead_hammer'><u>Lead Hammer</u></click> <property>a few times</property> to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>crush</shake> it into <property>2</property> <bone>Brick Dust</bone>

Положи <keyword>терракоту</keyword> на <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/tree_stump'><u>пень</u></click> через <keyword>ПКМ</keyword> и ударь по ней <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/lead_hammer'><u>свинцовым молотом</u></click> <property>несколько раз</property> - она <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>раскрошится</shake> в <property>2</property> <bone>кирпичной пыли</bone>
